_about: George Sidney Brett (1879-1944), philosopher and historian of psychology at Toronto. Raw IA OCR: The Philosophy of Gassendi (London: Macmillan, 1908), The Government of Man, an introduction to ethics and politics (London: George Bell, 1913), and A History of Psychology in three volumes: I, Ancient and Patristic (London: George Allen, 1912), II, Medieval and Early Modern Period (1921; the verso reads 'First published in ig2i') and III, Modern Psychology (1921; the verso reads 'First published in igii', OCR for 1921). Not Brett-Feijoo (shelf brett-feijoo). Psychology Ancient and Modern (1928) was not found in a scan with a printed year. US public domain. No uids minted.
